# Devex

> > Global development news and intelligence platform connecting professionals in international development, humanitarian aid, and global health sectors.

Devex serves the international development community with news coverage, career resources, and data analysis on major institutions including USAID, UN, IDB, OECD DAC, and Africa CDC. The platform tracks development finance trends, ODA flows, sector hiring patterns, and emerging donor strategies across climate, health, and humanitarian programming.

## Key Topics

- USAID
- United Nations (UN)
- Development Assistance Committee (DAC)
- OECD
- Official Development Assistance (ODA)
- Inter-American Development Bank (IDB)
- International development
- Development jobs and careers
- Global health
- Development finance
- Humanitarian aid
- Climate development
- INGOs (International NGOs)
- Consulting contracts
- 2025 aid trends

## Core Platform

- [Devex Homepage](https://www.devex.com): Media platform for global development community covering IDB, USAID & more
- [Devex Career Center](https://www.devex.com/career-center): Development jobs hub covering USAID, UN & humanitarian career opportunities
- [Content Series](https://www.devex.com/content-series): Curated series on humanitarian, health & sustainability topics

## Career Guides

- [Your ultimate guide to development's top sectors in 2025](https://www.devex.com/downloadables/your-ultimate-guide-to-development-s-top-sectors-in-2025-60): Analysis of 10 leading development sectors & hiring trends for 2025
- [Your guide to a successful UN application](https://www.devex.com/downloadables/your-guide-to-a-successful-un-application-33): UN job application guide covering Inspira, UNICEF & interview strategies
- [Your guide to negotiating consulting contracts](https://www.devex.com/downloadables/your-guide-to-negotiating-consulting-contracts-12): Expert guide to consulting contract negotiation & rate planning
- [How aid cuts hit development jobs in 2025](https://www.devex.com/downloadables/how-aid-cuts-hit-development-jobs-in-2025-59): Data analysis of 2025 aid cuts impact on development job market

## Development Finance & Aid Analysis

- [Where does ODA go?](https://www.devex.com/downloadables/where-does-oda-go-28): $251.5B ODA spending analysis by DAC donors & allocation trends
- [Emerging Donors 3.0](https://www.devex.com/downloadables/emerging-donors-3-0-25): Report on emerging donor strategies, ODA trends & DAC transformation
- [The 50 largest US INGOs - and where they get their money](https://www.devex.com/downloadables/the-50-largest-us-ingos-and-where-they-get-their-money-27): Top 50 US INGOs ranked by revenue sources & executive compensation

## Sector Reports

- [The evolution of the HIV and AIDS response](https://www.devex.com/downloadables/the-evolution-of-the-hiv-and-aids-response-34): PEPFAR progress report on HIV/AIDS response toward 2030 SDG goals
